services.title: Tree Felling & Removal
services.desc: Safe removal of dead, diseased, or unwanted trees of any size. We handle site clearance and responsible timber disposal or salvage.

services.title: Crown Reduction & Shaping
services.desc: Reduce weight and improve balance without harming the tree's health. Ideal for overgrown specimens blocking light or views.

services.title: Pruning & Maintenance
services.desc: Expert deadwood removal, formative pruning, and seasonal maintenance to promote growth and extend tree lifespan.

services.title: Emergency Storm Damage
services.desc: We respond 24/7 to fallen branches and uprooted trees, making your property safe and removing hazards fast.

services.title: Stump Grinding & Removal
services.desc: Complete stump extraction below ground level, leaving your garden clear and ready for landscaping or replanting.

services.title: Tree Health Assessment
services.desc: Professional diagnosis of disease, pest damage, or structural weakness. We advise on treatment or safe removal options.

about_pullquote: We don't just fell trees—we care for the ones worth keeping.
about_para_1: Gateshead Tree Care has been serving Newcastle and surrounding areas for 18 years. Founded on the principle that expert tree work shouldn't be rushed or reckless, we've built a reputation for combining speed with safety. Our team holds NPTC qualifications and works to BS 3998 standards, ensuring every cut protects the tree's future—or its neighbours.
about_para_2: Homeowners and business owners return to us because we explain what needs doing and why, never overselling unnecessary work. We're fully insured, carry our own equipment, and arrive within hours for emergencies. If a tree can be saved, we'll save it. If it has to go, we remove it cleanly and recycle the timber wherever possible.
reviews_heading: What Newcastle Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Had a massive oak hanging over the house after the storm last month. These lads turned up within 90 minutes, had it down safely, and cleared everything the same day. Professional, polite, and honest about costs. Can't fault them.
reviews.author: Mark H.

reviews.text: Our sycamore was diseased and dropping branches everywhere. The surveyor explained exactly what was wrong and why it needed removing. Brilliant crew, minimal mess, and they even chipped the wood for us. Would use again.
reviews.author: Catherine B.

reviews.text: Called them at 10pm on a Sunday when a massive branch came down on the fence. They answered, came out that night, made it safe, and sorted the stump properly a week later. Exactly what you need in an emergency. Really impressed.
reviews.author: David T.
